system.description:
On a failed Evasion roll against your Physical Potency, the target takes damage equal to [6 x Soul].

You gain a +1 Physical Potency for this ability, gaining a further +1 for every size category larger than Medium your target is.

If Annihilate is active when Heart Killer is used, this ability fails and Annihilates base damage increases by [6 x Soul].
